sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your flexibility in providing multiple options and are pleased to accept the 24-month contract duration and the later effective date of 1 April 2027. In exchange for these adjustments, we propose a compromise of 45 days for the payment terms to support our operations. Accordingly, we can offer a revised price of €51.80 per unit, reflecting our dedication to our long-standing partnership.

Our present offer is a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. It remains valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and valid from 1 April 2027: €51.80 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
